sync.title: Pending entries
sync.confirmDiscard: Delete this refused entry? It will not be saved.
sync.refusedAlert_one: {{count}} entry was refused by the server: open “Sync” to check it.
sync.refusedAlert_other: {{count}} entries were refused by the server: open “Sync” to check them.
sync.refusedHelp: What to do: read the reason, enter it again correctly (e.g. right number or right flock), then delete this one.
sync.rule1: Each entry gets a unique number on the phone: even if the connection drops while sending, it is never recorded twice.
sync.rule2: Offline, entries are only added: nothing is edited or deleted, so two people cannot contradict each other on the same record.
sync.rule3: When sending, the server checks everything again against current data (flock closed meanwhile, more birds than remaining, credit ceiling…). If the entry is no longer valid it is refused and stays here with the reason.
sync.rule4: If two people enter the same thing (same sale, same laying, same mortality), Kenfack and Ali get a “possible duplicate” alert to check.

faceid.title: Sign in with {{nom}}
faceid.subtitle: Open HENZO without typing your password: your phone recognises you.
faceid.point1: Your face or fingerprint never leaves the phone: HENZO never receives it. The phone only confirms it is you.
faceid.point2: Your password still works: you can always use it, for example on another device.
faceid.point3: If you lose this phone, remove it from the list below (or ask Ali to change your password).
faceid.activateHint: For safety, confirm your HENZO password first. The phone will then ask for {{nom}}.
faceid.doneText: All set: next time, tap “Sign in with {{nom}}”.
faceid.confirmRemove: Remove “{{nom}}”? This device will no longer sign in without the password.
faceid.unsupported: This device or browser does not support Face ID or fingerprint sign-in.
faceid.disabled: Face ID sign-in is not enabled on the server yet (Supabase > Authentication > Passkeys).
faceid.unknown: No Face ID access saved for HENZO on this device: sign in with your password, then turn on Face ID.
faceid.tip: Sign in faster with {{nom}}, without typing your password.
faceid.point4: On this phone HENZO then stays signed in: no more sign-out after 30 minutes, since the phone is already locked by {{nom}}.
